name: seasonal-color-analysis
description: Color Analysis – WordPress site with the Seasonal Color Toolkit plugin

scripts.build:js: esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-engine.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-engine.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-palette.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-palette.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-color.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-color.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-generator.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-generator.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-quiz.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-quiz.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-photo-measure.js --minify --target=es2017 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-photo-measure.min.js && esbuild wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-photo.js --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=wp-content/plugins/seasonal-color-toolkit/assets/js/sca-photo.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:images
